pe_export_ordinal_mechanism.prior_report_clarification: The prior report noted 'export 701 / import 751'. In fact, FunctionIndex is 701 (0-based in AddressOfFunctions), Base is 50, so ExportOrdinal = 50 + 701 = 751. LUMIXTether.exe imports from Lmxptpif.dll strictly by ordinal (all 272 imports are by ordinal), requesting Ordinal 751. They are the exact same entry; 701 is the internal array index, and 751 is the formal PE export ordinal.

host_buffer_vs_target_address_distinctio.host_buffer: Pointers passed into functions such as LMX_func_api_SetupFilesConfigSetting_Get_Data (0xc(%rbp)) and LMX_func_api_Get_Partial_Object (%rdx) are destinations in host PC virtual RAM where the PTP transport copies received packet payloads.
host_buffer_vs_target_address_distinctio.target_device_address: No vendor export accepts or constructs a target physical memory/bus address (RAM/ROM) for the camera. Parameters transmitted in PTP request containers are strictly PTP Object Handles, sub-command tags (e.g. 0x80030001, 0x80040001, 0x800000a2, 0x15c00021), or property IDs.

strongest_3_unresolved_candidates.name: LMX_func_api_Mnt_GetInfo_Get_Version
strongest_3_unresolved_candidates.response_handling: Receives fixed 4-byte version response and copies DWORD into caller pointer.

mac_counterpart.semantic_comparison: Structurally identical. Constructs PTP 0x9703 with sub-command 0x80030001 and constant 0x20001; writes 4-byte version to output pointer.

strongest_3_unresolved_candidates.evaluation: Diagnostic/maintenance query; returns version number only, no memory read capability.

strongest_3_unresolved_candidates.name: LMX_func_api_Mnt_Set_UsbMode

mac_counterpart.semantic_comparison: Identical logic. Mac calls helper __Z23LMX_func_api_SetMntInfo (exported in Mac dylib, internal static in Windows DLL at RVA 0x1b090) with sub-command 0x80040001 and opcode 0x9704.

strongest_3_unresolved_candidates.evaluation: Maintenance mode control; sets USB operation mode, no arbitrary memory write/read.

strongest_3_unresolved_candidates.name: LMX_func_api_SetupFilesConfigSetting_Get_Data
strongest_3_unresolved_candidates.response_handling: Copies variable binary configuration stream into host buffer 0xc(%rbp) bounded by length 0x14(%rbp).

mac_counterpart.semantic_comparison: Identical binary configuration backup path using 0x9421 / 0x800000a2.

strongest_3_unresolved_candidates.evaluation: Returns real binary data, but it is an opaque high-level serialized camera configuration file, not arbitrary device RAM/ROM addressable dump.

alternative_read_candidates_evaluated.name: LMX_func_api_Get_Partial_Object
alternative_read_candidates_evaluated.evaluation: Standard PTP GetPartialObject (ObjectHandle, Offset, MaxBytes). Offset is file offset inside camera storage object, not target hardware address.

alternative_read_candidates_evaluated.name: LMX_func_api_Setup_Exec_Pixel_Refresh_Comp
alternative_read_candidates_evaluated.evaluation: Passes 0x15c00022 confirmation command. Windows-only wrapper for pixel refresh completion notification.

conclusion_and_next_step.summary: Full PE export audit (513 exports, 241 unimported) confirms no hidden arbitrary memory reading or physical dump routines exist in Lmxptpif.dll. All 20 Windows-only exports are camera UI/calibration wrappers (tone curves, setup ranges, refresh completion).
conclusion_and_next_step.next_concrete_candidate: None within host Tether client software. Any future diagnostic read capability must target camera-side PTP firmware dispatchers (auditing firmware handlers for opcodes 0x97xx, 0x94xx, 0x96xx) rather than client-side tethering binaries.
